title: Abrar v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Surya Prakash Kesarwani, J.; Dr. Yogendra Kumar Srivastava, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; petitioner relegated to clause 6.5; no merits opinion.
headnote: Writ challenging the Executive Engineer's arrear determination of Rs.1,81,302/- and disconnection of supply is disposed of. The consumer is given liberty to approach the competent authority under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. If approached within two weeks with a copy of the order, that authority shall decide the dispute expeditiously, preferably within three weeks, in accordance with law after hearing. No opinion on merits.
facts: The petitioner, Abrar, challenged an order dated 27 June 2020 of the Executive Engineer, Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited, Hapur, which determined electricity arrears of Rs.1,81,302/- and disconnected the connection. The High Court heard counsel for the petitioner, the standing counsel for the State, and counsel for the distribution licensee. The licensee's counsel submitted that a remedy lay under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and that the petitioner could approach the Executive Engineer.

holding_units.topic: billing dispute / arrear assessment / disconnection — statutory objection
holding_units.holding: A writ challenging the Executive Engineer's order determining arrears and disconnecting supply is disposed of by giving liberty to the consumer to approach the competent authority under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. If the consumer approaches that authority within two weeks with a copy of the order, the authority shall decide the dispute expeditiously, preferably within three weeks, in accordance with law after affording a reasonable opportunity of hearing. The Court expressed no opinion on merits.

principle_tags.application: Writ against the Executive Engineer's arrear determination and disconnection was disposed by relegating the consumer to the Clause 6.5 remedy, with a time-bound direction to decide if approached within two weeks.
The disputed arrear assessment of Rs.1,81,302/- and consequent disconnection were left to the Clause 6.5 competent authority; the writ court did not examine the bill on merits.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the Rs.1,81,302/- arrear determination and the disconnection
not_decided.note: The Court expressly stated it had not expressed any opinion on the merits of the petitioner's case.
